name: pramanyx
description: Governed answers from your Pramanyx install: questions, deep analyses, metrics and definitions, each with its Trust Receipt.
long_description: Runs the MCP server of the Pramanyx install on this computer (`python -m pramanyx.mcp`), a thin client of that install's API: every answer takes the governed path the app takes, and the organisation's agent policy decides which of these tools are offered. It is not self-contained: choose the Python inside your Pramanyx install's virtual environment, and say where its API answers. A Pramanyx on another machine is reached with its HTTP transport instead (docs/MCP_SERVER.md).

python.title: Pramanyx's Python
python.description: The python inside your Pramanyx install's virtual environment: <install>/.venv/bin/python (on Windows, <install>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe).

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your Pramanyx API key, when the install asks for one. Leave it empty on an install without sign-in.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the databases Pramanyx can answer about.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: A question in words, answered by Pramanyx's governed path, with its Trust Receipt.

tools.name: deep_analysis
tools.description: A multi-step analysis for why and what-drove-it questions.

tools.name: get_investigation
tools.description: Read a deep analysis by its id, finished or still running.

tools.name: get_metric
tools.description: A governed metric's value and definition.

tools.name: get_definitions
tools.description: What the organisation's business words mean.

tools.name: draft_definition
tools.description: Draft what a word means for the person, for its owner to publish.

tools.name: read_learned
tools.description: What Pramanyx has learned about a connection, each item with where it came from.

tools.name: bring_in_file
tools.description: Bring a file the person attached into Pramanyx as their own sheet or document.

tools.name: remember_for_me

tools.name: my_memories
tools.description: What this person asked to be remembered.

tools.name: forget_for_me

tools.name: deck_of_answers
tools.description: Several answers as one PowerPoint deck, built from their stored reports.

tools.name: search_my_drive
tools.description: Find files in this person's own Google Drive by name: names and links, never contents.

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: What Pramanyx's explorer has already found on a connection.

tools.name: get_briefing
tools.description: The executive Briefing for a connection.

tools.name: explore
tools.description: Start Pramanyx's background exploration of a connection.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Pramanyx's running and recent background work.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One background job: its agent, state and cost.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a running background job.

tools.name: search_graph
tools.description: Search what Pramanyx knows about a connection: tables, metrics, terms, findings.

tools.name: describe_entity

tools.name: list_areas

tools.name: get_table_health

tools.name: list_trusted_queries
tools.description: The verified query patterns for a connection, each with its warrant.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Recent runs, newest first.

tools.name: inspect_run
tools.description: Where one run's time and cost went, and what failed.

tools.name: read_run_span
tools.description: One step of a run, its input and output.

tools.name: read_contract
tools.description: The contract Pramanyx holds every agent to.

tools.name: read_claims
tools.description: What the organisation holds true, now or as recorded on a date.

tools.name: read_restatements

tools.name: post_claim
tools.description: Post a claim with its warrant, as yourself.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: A page of a business entity's objects through the published ontology.

tools.name: schedule

tools.name: search_the_web

tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Draft an email for the person to read, change and send themselves.
